name: Nibha Utpreksha

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Nibha Utpreksha is a Hindi poet based in Begusarai, Bihar. Her writing is also part of the spoken poetry tradition: a report of Sahitya Shakti Sansthan’s January 2023 online poetry festival records her participation with a geet.

Her Kabita Live poems consider the cost of ambition, betrayal and careless speech. ‘सबसे आगे बढ़ते रहना, अच्छी बात है।’ asks what success means when companionship is lost along the way, moving through short reflections on everyday conduct. ‘दुर्मर्ष दर्द के ‌मंजर देखे’ uses a recurring refrain to return to the hurt concealed beneath appearances of affection.
